description: Demand surge on all Beverages in the Southeast region during July 2026 (2026-W28..W31); MEIO plans for it and the Twin simulates it; compared against baseline.
hypothesis: A +25% beverage demand surge in the Southeast for 4 weeks will strain Southeast DC stock and inbound replenishment; the prepared arm (MEIO anticipates the surge) should hold fill rates and reduce lost sales versus the unprepared arm, at the cost of higher inventory.
request_text: What if Southeast beverage demand rises 25% in July?

overrides.rationale: Planner's request: "What if Southeast beverage demand rises 25% in July?" — +25% uplift on beverage demand across the Southeast region for the July 2026 weeks (W28–W31). Planner did not state visibility, so the change is applied to both sides: MEIO plans for it (prepared arm) and the Twin simulates it; the unprepared arm already covers the surprise case.
